description: Prospect Storm Board is the pre-MLB support layer for Storm Watch. It is not a public leaderboard and does not change B6-Air.

source.name: MLB Pipeline prospect stats via pybaseball.top_prospects(playerType='batters')
source.levelContextNote: age/level context included at 15%; ALL-level rows use a coarse neutral level score
source.missingIdTeamPositionLimitations: pybaseball output has no MLBAM id, team/org, or position fields.

categories.Top Prospect Power: Top rank/consensus plus strong current minor-league power support.
categories.Under-the-Radar Power: Lower rank/consensus within this table plus strong current power support.
categories.Power Risk: Strong power support with high strikeout risk.
categories.Contact Foundation: Strong approach/contact support with less power.
categories.Not Enough Data: Too little PA for a current descriptive read.

bridgePlan.purpose: When a prospect graduates into Storm Watch, carry forward current Pipeline rank/stats/support context.
bridgePlan.joinNeed: Future bridge needs MLBAM/player ID or strict normalized name + age + org matching. Current Pipeline stats table does not include IDs, org/team, or position.
